mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods where FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 6.0% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which may prompt the Fed to delay rate hikes or initiate cuts, boosting equity risk appetite and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative or flat 20-day returns in 60% or more of instances where UNRATE exceeds 6.0% for 3 months, or the signal's Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1,400,000 units over two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and residential investment, which may trigger a policy response that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in 60% of triggered instances, or the signal's Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 105.0 for two consecutive months indicates weakening real economic activity, which may lead to a policy pivot toward stimulus, increasing equity risk appetite and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative or flat in more than 50% of triggered periods, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (proxy: RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction, which may trigger a dovish policy response and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 1400.0 and RSAFS < 615000.0 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in more than 60% of interaction-triggered instances, or the joint signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% combined with a decline in industrial production below 105.0 signals a tightening cycle coinciding with weakening supply, which may increase recession risk and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and INDPRO < 105.0 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in payroll employment growth below 50,000 per month for two consecutive months, combined with a rising unemployment rate, signals labor market deterioration that may prompt aggressive monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth < 50.0 and UNRATE > 6.0% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 615,000 million dollars combined with a drop in housing starts below 1,400,000 units signals a collapse in consumer demand, which may lead to a policy response that supports equity markets, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 615000.0 and HOUST < 1400.0 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the joint signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
